You are restyling a React page to a new DARK "black & blue" design system. WRITE CODE. Do NOT run npm build (orchestrator verifies). Do NOT change any business logic, handlers, API calls, state, or component structure. Only rewrite className/markup for styling, move static inline styles to classes, and add design-state components (empty/loading/confirm).

FIRST read the design-system file at "/Users/rayhan/Desktop/Code projects/Openglimpse/src/client/src/index.css". Use ONLY classes defined there plus standard Tailwind utilities (flex, gap-*, p-*, m-*, w-*, h-*, text-*, bg-*, border-*, rounded-*, sm:/md:/lg: suffixes, min-w-0, truncate, capitalize, etc.). Custom color utilities: bg-bg, bg-surface, bg-surface-2, text-ink, text-muted, text-accent, text-ok, text-bad, text-warn, border-edge, bg-accent, bg-accent-deep, bg-ok-dim, bg-bad-dim, bg-warn-dim + opacity modifiers.

DESIGN LANGUAGE:
- Dark theme. Root: <main className="page">. bg #0b0d10. Cards bg-surface. Elevated bg-surface-2.
- Accent blue #3b82f6. Danger red (text-bad/bg-bad-dim/bg-bad-solid via btn-danger-solid).
- Header: <header className="topbar"> with .page-title "Profile".
- Staff toggle (My Profile / Participants): use .segmented (.segmented-btn/.segmented-btn-active) inside px-4 pb-3.
- ProfileSection: .card-pad. Profile hero row: .avatar .avatar-lg .avatar-accent (initial) + name (.title) + role (.meta capitalize). Edit form: .field/.field-label + .input for name/email/password. Error .field-error, success .banner banner-success. Save button "btn btn-primary btn-lg btn-block". Then action row: Logout "btn btn-secondary flex-1" and Delete Account "btn btn-danger flex-1".
- Replace window.confirm for account deletion with ConfirmDialog: import ConfirmDialog from '../../components/shared/ConfirmDialog'. Add const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState(false); Logout button just logs out (no confirm). Delete button sets confirmDelete(true). Render ConfirmDialog open={confirmDelete} title="Delete account?" message="This cannot be undone. Your account will be permanently removed." confirmLabel="Delete" danger onConfirm={handleDelete} onCancel={() => setConfirmDelete(false)}. Remove the window.confirm line inside handleDelete.
- ParticipantSection: two cards. Accounts card (.card-pad): header .title "Accounts". Account rows: .row style bg-surface-2 rounded-xl border-edge with name (.row-title), email (.meta), role pill (.pill .pill-accent for staff, .pill-neutral for participant), Edit/Delete buttons "btn btn-sm btn-ghost" / "btn btn-sm btn-ghost text-bad". Empty accounts -> EmptyState (icon PersonAdd, title "No accounts yet"). 
- Create/Edit Account card (.card-pad): .title header. Form: .field/.field-label + .input for name/email/password; role .select. Error/success messages.
- Face Registration fieldset: .card-pad or a bordered block (bg-surface-2 border-edge rounded-xl p-3) with legend text .field-label. Source tabs: .segmented (URL/Upload/Camera). URL input row: .input + Load "btn btn-secondary btn-sm". File input: class .input (or keep file: styling minimal). Camera: video className "camera-video" wrapped in .camera-frame, hidden canvas keeps style display none (this is a functional hidden canvas; keep inline style display:'none' as it is required and not cosmetic, or use className "hidden" Tailwind class). Capture button "btn btn-primary btn-sm". Face preview: .avatar .avatar-lg with img object-cover rounded-full + Remove button "btn btn-danger btn-sm".
- Submit button: "btn btn-primary btn-lg btn-block" with disabled state when uploadingFace or missing face image; label shows "Uploading face..." when busy (loading via spinner-sm inline). Cancel button when editing: "btn btn-secondary btn-lg btn-block".
- Remove inline style={{ minHeight: '100dvh' }} on main (page class handles it).
- Icons: keep @mui/icons-material. Remove ALL sx={{...}} props.
- Comments: short plain labels, NO em dashes.
- Mobile-first (~390px); wrap in max-w-2xl mx-auto on desktop.

FILE TO REWRITE (read first):
/Users/rayhan/Desktop/Code projects/Openglimpse/src/client/src/pages/auth/ProfilePage.jsx

Only remove window.confirm per above.

After rewriting, reply with a concise summary and confirm all handlers are intact.
